# Strategic Flow — Audit & Architecture

> Strategic Flow is a SaaS email and content audit platform. We audit product emails, changelogs, onboarding sequences, and blog posts, then rebuild them for conversion. Architecture module included for ongoing email system rebuilds.

## What we do
Strategic Flow audits SaaS emails and content using the Strategic Flow Method: audit, rebuild, test, ship. Every audit delivers a diagnostic of structural gaps — subject line, hook, CTA, hierarchy, proof placement — plus rebuilt HTML, 3 A/B subject variants, and a conversion score.

The Architecture module is built into this app. It provides a full email system rebuild for retainer clients: every product update email rebuilt before it ships, ongoing changelog architecture, and onboarding sequence restructuring.

## Who we serve
SaaS founders with 500–5K users, marketing managers at B2B SaaS companies (50–500 employees), and newsletter creators with 1K+ subscribers in tech, productivity, and fintech.

## Services
- Single audit: $49 one-time
- Lite: $299/month, 4 rebuilds
- Growth: $499/month, 10 rebuilds
- High-Impact: $899/month, unlimited rebuilds
- Architecture: $2,500/month, full email system rebuild and ongoing retainer

## Audit modules
Changelog Audit, Onboarding Audit, LinkedIn Audit. Available in English, Spanish, Swedish, French, Romanian, and German.
